name: animated-data-table
title: Animated Data Table
description: Sort, filter, select and reorder rows that glide into place.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette for the table, its menus and the action bar. Selected rows and primary buttons take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: staggerRows
props.label: Stagger rows
props.description: Rows appear one after another when the table loads or changes.

props.name: staggerCells
props.label: Stagger cells
props.description: Cells inside each row also appear one after another.

props.name: numberAnimation
props.label: Number animation
props.description: How numbers change: roll digit by digit, count up, or switch instantly.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long each animation takes, in seconds.

props.name: stagger
props.label: Stagger
props.description: Delay between each row or cell appearing, in seconds.

props.name: rowHighlight
props.label: Row highlight
props.description: How the hover highlight moves between rows: slides, fills from the top, or none.

props.name: rowHighlightColor
props.label: Row highlight color
props.description: Colour of the row highlight: soft grey or the theme's primary colour.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: Header and button labels roll to a second copy on hover.

props.name: showStatusFilter
props.label: Show status filter
props.description: Shows the status filter above the table.

props.name: highlightTotal
props.label: Highlight total
props.description: Highlights the total figure in the footer.

props.name: showPagination
props.label: Show pagination
props.description: Splits the rows into pages with next and previous buttons.

props.name: selectable
props.label: Row checkboxes
props.description: Adds a checkbox to every row.

props.name: showSelectAll
props.label: Show select all
props.description: Shows the select-all checkbox in the header. Needs Row checkboxes on.

props.name: selectMark
props.label: Select mark
props.description: Mark shown in a selected row's checkbox: checkmark or filled circle. Needs Row checkboxes on.

props.name: showActionBar
props.label: Show action bar
props.description: Shows a floating action bar when rows are selected. Needs Row checkboxes on.

props.name: dragMode
props.label: Drag mode
props.description: Lets you drag rows up and down to reorder them.

props.name: showStatusBadges
props.label: Show status badges
props.description: Shows status as coloured badges instead of plain text.

props.name: expandable
props.label: Expandable preview
props.description: Rows open to reveal a preview underneath.

props.name: removable
props.label: Delete column
props.description: Adds a button to delete a column.

props.name: addable
props.label: Add rows
props.description: Adds a button to add new rows.

props.name: textAlign
props.label: Text alignment
props.description: Alignment of the text in the cells.

props.name: bordered
props.label: Border
props.description: Draws a border around the table.

props.name: showHorizontalLines
props.label: Show horizontal lines
props.description: Draws a line between rows.

props.name: showVerticalLines
props.label: Show vertical lines
props.description: Draws a line between columns.

props.name: showHeaderBorder
props.label: Show header border
props.description: Draws a line under the header row.

props.name: boldHeader
props.label: Bold header
props.description: Makes the header text bold.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.label: Sticky header
props.description: Keeps the header in view while the rows scroll.

props.name: expandFullTable
props.label: Expand full table
props.description: Grows the table to show every row instead of scrolling inside it.

props.name: height
props.label: Table height
props.description: Height of the table, as a percentage of the viewport. Ignored when Expand full table is on.

props.name: stickyFooter
props.label: Sticky last row
props.description: Keeps the last row pinned at the bottom while the rows scroll.

props.name: loadingSkeleton
props.label: Loading skeleton
props.description: Shows shimmering placeholders for a moment before the rows appear.
